hooks.command: grep -qE "pdftotext[^\"]*-layout" && printf "%s" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\", \"permissionDecisionReason\":\"pdftotext -layout puts rule numbers in a column that does not line up with their text,  and every wrong rule citation in this repo came from reading it anyway.  Use -raw instead: pdftotext -q -raw <pdf> - | grep -n <the sentence you mean>\"}}" || true

grep -qE "(Set-Content|Out-File|Add-Content)( +-[A-Za-z]+)* +\"?[^ |;&\"'+]*\.tsx?|>>? *\"?[^ |;&\"'+]*\.tsx?" && printf "%s" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\", \"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Shell writes to a .ts file are blocked in this repo: PowerShell mojibakes every em-dash  and adds a BOM, and a bare redirect loses the CRLF the repo uses. Use the Edit tool, or a Python round-trip with explicit  utf-8 and newline='' — which this hook deliberately allows.\"}}" || true

D="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; if [ -f "$D/packages/engine/dist/index.js" ] && [ -n "$(find "$D/packages/engine/src" -type f -newer "$D/packages/engine/dist/index.js" -print -quit 2>/dev/null)" ]; then printf "%s" "{\"systemMessage\":\"engine src/ is newer than dist/ - @rift-engine/web and every probe read dist, so an engine change is invisible to both until: npm run build --workspace=@rift-engine/engine\"}"; fi
